about_the_game:
ABOUT THIS DEMO

The CloserLook VR: Oldways Demo begins exactly where the full game does — in a quiet departmental library. In this demo, you'll experience the first half of Chapter One, solve intriguing puzzles, discover key items, and immerse yourself in a captivating story.

From the moment you wake up in the quiet departmental library, every step forward reveals layers of mystery and intrigue. As you transition from the mundane to the mysterious, solving intricate puzzles becomes the key to unlocking the secrets of this place. Each action pulls you deeper into a beautifully rendered West African setting, rich with history and culture. Along the way, you’ll recover stolen artifacts, piece together untold stories, and face challenges that test your wit and perseverance, making every moment an unforgettable part of your journey to freedom.

KEY FEATURES:

  • Rich Narrative:

    Uncover a deeply layered story with themes of corruption, exploitation, and unexpected twists. As you delve deeper, question motives and reconsider your initial assumptions as you discover a truth that is both intriguing and unsettling.

  • Intuitive and Engaging Puzzles:

    Challenge your observation and intuition with puzzles that seamlessly integrate into the narrative. Use tools and key items to navigate a unique loactions designed to keep you trapped.

  • A Unique VR Experience:

    CloserLook VR pushes the boundaries of virtual reality immersion. With unparalleled attention to detail, it offers a custom-crafted world and story designed to captivate and immerse you from beginning to end.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel CPU Core i5 7600 3ghz
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060/AMD Radeon RX 480 or greater
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • VR Support: SteamVR or OpenXR
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel CPU Core i7 4790 3ghz
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GPU GeForce RTX 2070 / AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • VR Support: SteamVR or OpenXR

short_description: CloserLook VR: Oldways is a story-driven VR adventure set in modern-day West Africa. Trapped in a university building, explore secret locations, solve puzzles, and uncover a gripping narrative of exploitation, corruption, and betrayal.
supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain
*languages with full audio support
